leftEvidence.title: Peter quotes David and says God made Jesus Lord and Christ

points.label: Claim and sight
points.left: Peter quotes David and says God made Jesus Lord and Christ
points.right: Stephen says he sees Jesus standing at God’s right hand

points.label: Audience response
points.left: Peter says David died and was buried, speaks of resurrection and exaltation, quotes the psalm, and names Jesus as Lord and Christ.
points.right: Before he is stoned, Stephen sees God’s glory and Jesus standing at God’s right hand, names what he sees, and calls on the Lord Jesus.

payload.posture: Read both passages while keeping each speaker, setting, action, and later argument in its own setting.

rightEvidence.title: Stephen says he sees Jesus standing at God’s right hand

payload.tension: Acts moves from a public argument using David’s words to a vision named during Stephen’s death.
payload.title: Jesus proclaimed and seen at God’s right hand
